pages.text: These mighty multi-segmented creatures fascinate you; you found a way to fold their power into a focus so you can summon them at any time.

Casting with a $(l:crafts/staff/nether_staff)Nether Staff$() or a $(l:crafts/staff/wild_staff)Wild Staff$() summons extras; if you wear the Nether set and cast with a Nether Staff, what you summon is a $(l:supreme/servants/war_python)Royal War Python$().
